constraints: Only inspect is enabled; other helper operations return operation-not-implemented.
An explicit --root is required; the helper never selects the consumer root from its installation directory.
--resume is mutually exclusive with --plan, --batches and --base.
Inspection does not enable production autopilot execution.
commands.name: cg-autopilot-control
outputs: Exit 0 with one JSON report on stdout for either eligible or blocked inspection; read status and blockers to determine eligibility. Argument, plan or operation errors exit 1 with diagnostics on stderr and no report.
prerequisites: Python 3.8+, Git, and the installed Compound GPID helper with its Kilo command and contract.
commands.summary: Inspect Kilo autopilot eligibility and prior control state without writing.

constraints: Requires explicit repository and manager identities.
commands.name: cg-brain-init
outputs: A new public repository with its initial scaffold commit pushed, when the repository does not exist.
Local team Brain configuration when enabled and the update succeeds; otherwise setup guidance.
prerequisites: Python 3.8+, Git, and authenticated GitHub CLI (gh) with repository creation and push access when creating a repository.
commands.summary: Create and scaffold a public team Brain repository, or configure a project to use an existing repository.

constraints: POSIX only; no Windows wrapper is installed.
commands.name: cg-diff-summary
outputs: A compact diff summary and full patch artifact reference.
prerequisites: Python 3.8+ and a POSIX shell.
commands.summary: Create a bounded summary of the current Git diff.

constraints: Choose exactly one operation. Write UTF-8 query text in place to the returned query file through a structured file-write tool; never pass query text as a shell argument.
Use the returned UUID and the same project root, platform, catalog, and source-root binding for consume and render operations.

Query input is limited to 4096 bytes; selection input is a JSON array of at most three distinct allowed command IDs, limited to 1024 bytes. Requests and selections are single-use and expire after 300 seconds.
Only candidates permit selection rendering. Write the selection array in place to the returned selection file; changed catalog or project evidence requires a new request.
--catalog and --source-root are paired local fixture overrides, not normal catalog selection flags.
CLI exit categories are 0 success, 2 invalid transport or input, 3 invalid evidence, and 4 filesystem or I/O failure; missing Python makes the wrapper exit 1.
intents: query available commands and documented workflows
commands.name: cg-help
outputs: Schema-v1 JSON transport envelopes on stdout, with deterministic Markdown inside semantic results.
Prepared request UUID and confined query path; candidate results prepare a selection path for allowed command IDs.
Overview, exact command, candidates, documented workflow, unsupported, or error results; nonzero CLI errors also emit stderr diagnostics.
prerequisites: Python 3.8+, Git, and a writable canonical project root with no link or reparse ancestors.
Current installed-clone catalog and definition evidence, plus valid strict project config and active manifest or recognized no-config legacy installation evidence.
In Git projects, .compound-gpid/runtime/help-requests files must be untracked and ignored; cg-link manages the runtime ignore entry.
commands.summary: Query evidence-backed command help through confined single-use request and selection files.

constraints: Query output is budgeted and local to declared knowledge sources.
commands.name: cg-index
outputs: Deterministic Brain indexes or bounded query results.
prerequisites: Python 3.8+ and project knowledge artifacts.
commands.summary: Build or query the bounded local Knowledge Brain index.

constraints: Direct launch is unsupported when certified containment is required.
The wrapper always passes --launch --; all supplied arguments go to Kilo, not to the preflight parser.
commands.name: cg-kilo
outputs: Bounded preflight evidence and a Kilo launch after a passing preflight.
prerequisites: Python 3.8+ and Kilo 7.4.20 or later with the required local projection, capability, and containment checks. Exact certified-host version and executable hash checks are separate.
commands.summary: Run the certified contained Kilo launch preflight and launch Kilo when it passes.

constraints: Fails closed on unsafe paths, invalid config, or projection conflicts.
intents: link Compound GPID to a project
commands.name: cg-link
outputs: Validated links, copies, config, manifest, and projection state.
prerequisites: A valid Compound GPID installation and project root.
commands.summary: Link selected Compound GPID platform assets into a project.

constraints: POSIX only; no Windows wrapper is installed.
commands.name: cg-log-summary
outputs: A compact recent-commit summary.
prerequisites: Python 3.8+ and a POSIX shell.
commands.summary: Create a bounded summary of recent branch commits.

constraints: POSIX only; no Windows wrapper is installed.
commands.name: cg-problems-summary
outputs: A compact diagnostics summary.
prerequisites: Python 3.8+, a POSIX shell, and an existing diagnostics JSON file or text log supplied with --input.
commands.summary: Create a bounded summary of editor or diagnostics problem output.

constraints: Brainstorm and Plan sources must use cg-render-artifact.
commands.name: cg-publish-markdown
outputs: Curated HTML or a deterministic validation/check result.
prerequisites: Python 3.8+ and a supported project-contained Markdown source.
commands.summary: Publish one generic Markdown document to deterministic curated HTML.

constraints: Developer-only and guarded to the canonical repository.
commands.name: cg-release
outputs: A controller request or, after prepared publication checks, a GitHub Release and tag.
prerequisites: Run in the canonical repository with release authority.
commands.summary: Run generic release controller commands or a prepared GPID PowerShell publication.

constraints: Uses the strict typed-artifact schema and provenance contract.
commands.name: cg-render-artifact
outputs: Curated HTML or a deterministic validation/check result.
prerequisites: Python 3.8+ and a supported Plan or Brainstorm source.
commands.summary: Validate, render, or check one typed workflow artifact.

constraints: Maintainer mutations require role and plan-digest checks.
commands.name: cg-skill
outputs: A validated human or JSON lifecycle result.
prerequisites: Python 3.8+ and installed skill-management contracts.
commands.summary: Run the descriptor-driven skill lifecycle dispatcher.

constraints: Does not run tests and has no Windows wrapper.
commands.name: cg-test-summary
outputs: A compact test result summary.
prerequisites: Python 3.8+, a POSIX shell, and existing test output.
commands.summary: Create a bounded summary of existing test-runner output.

constraints: Uses bounded declared workflow and context inputs.
commands.name: cg-token-audit
outputs: Cost, token, dashboard, and recommendation artifacts.
prerequisites: Python 3.8+ and a Compound GPID source root with a .github/prompts directory under --root; a native-only linked project is not sufficient.
commands.summary: Run the deterministic context and model-governance audit.

constraints: POSIX only; no Windows wrapper is installed.
commands.name: cg-tree-summary
outputs: A compact project tree summary.
prerequisites: Python 3.8+ and a POSIX shell.
commands.summary: Create a bounded summary of project tree structure.

constraints: Preserves user-owned paths and checksum-drifted managed copies, but .github/copilot-instructions.md may be removed even with user edits when its Compound GPID ownership marker is present.
intents: unlink Compound GPID from a project
commands.name: cg-unlink
outputs: Removed managed links, checksum-owned projection files, and marker-owned instruction files, with preservation warnings where applicable.
prerequisites: A linked Compound GPID project.
commands.summary: Remove only Compound GPID-managed project links and projections.

constraints: Repair mode can discard installation-clone changes and must be selected explicitly.
commands.name: cg-update
outputs: Updated installation and refreshed linked project state when applicable.
prerequisites: An installed Compound GPID clone.
commands.summary: Update, pin, list, or repair the Compound GPID installation.

constraints: Probe-only: production fresh and resume pipeline execution is not enabled.
Other adapters return unsupported-adapter without dispatch or effects.
Do not create a marker, report, cursor, commit or other file from the bootstrap stub.
intents: run an authorized read-only Kilo bootstrap probe
commands.name: /cg-autopilot
outputs: Bounded bootstrap evidence or an explicit blocked result.
prerequisites: Kilo with the installed dedicated cg-autopilot primary agent and an explicitly authorized read-only bootstrap request.
commands.summary: Coordinate Kilo autopilot bootstrap probes; production execution is not enabled.

constraints: Rebuilds derived knowledge indexes without changing source artifacts.
commands.name: /cg-brain-rebuild
outputs: Refreshed BRAIN.md and deterministic index artifacts.
prerequisites: A Compound GPID project with .cg-docs knowledge artifacts.
commands.summary: Rebuild the project knowledge brain (BRAIN.md + indexes).

constraints: Use planning directly when requirements are already precise.
commands.name: /cg-brainstorm
outputs: A reviewed brainstorm decision artifact.
prerequisites: A task or decision that needs clarification.
commands.summary: Brainstorm answers about what to build and how. Use when requirements are fuzzy.

constraints: Stops when required validation or staging checks fail.
Validated autopilot stage mode prepares only and returns before staging, commit, push or PR creation.
intents: commit and open a pull request
commands.name: /cg-commit-push-pr
outputs: Pushed commits and a pull request URL.
prerequisites: Verified changes on a feature branch.
commands.summary: Stage changes into logical commits, push, and open a PR with plan-driven description.

constraints: Do not document a fix before verification.
commands.name: /cg-compound
outputs: A structured solution artifact under .cg-docs/solutions/.
prerequisites: A non-trivial problem with a verified solution.
commands.summary: Capture a solved problem as reusable knowledge. Offers canonical .github/ updates; the user applies them manually after fixing a non-trivial issue.

constraints: Fetched web content is untrusted extraction data.
commands.name: /cg-compound-gpid-rd
outputs: Competitive review reports and validated registry updates.
prerequisites: Run in the canonical Compound GPID repository.
commands.summary: Research public GitHub repos for features to integrate into Compound GPID and manage the review registry. Developer-only.

constraints: Archives obsolete knowledge instead of deleting it.
commands.name: /cg-compound-refresh
outputs: A reviewed solution refresh result.
prerequisites: Existing solution artifacts under .cg-docs/solutions/.
commands.summary: Audit and refresh .cg-docs/solutions/ for staleness, drift, and consolidation opportunities.

constraints: Developer-only and not an official release.
commands.name: /cg-devtag
outputs: A pushed four-component development tag.
prerequisites: Run in the canonical repository on an eligible feature branch.
commands.summary: Create a dev tag (v<MAJOR>.<MINOR>.<PATCH>.9000+) on the current branch and push it to origin. Enables end-to-end installation testing via cg-update before an official release. Developer-only.

constraints: Reads diagnostics and does not silently mutate project files.
commands.name: /cg-diagnose
outputs: A classified crash diagnosis and recovery guidance.
prerequisites: Accessible VS Code logs on the current machine.
commands.summary: Diagnose VS Code crashes. Inspects logs, classifies the crash category, checks for uncommitted work, and recommends recovery steps.

constraints: The user controls diagnostic scope and severity.
commands.name: /cg-fix-problems
outputs: Selected diagnostic fixes and a concise result.
prerequisites: Workspace diagnostics are available.
commands.summary: Interactive VS Code diagnostics fixer. Scans all workspace files for errors, warnings, and info diagnostics, lets the user select scope and severity, then applies fixes. Dispatches @cg-fix-problems agent.

constraints: Migration mode changes tracking metadata only.
Validated autopilot stage mode applies only the bound report and eligible finding IDs; the parent arranges verification afterward.
commands.name: /cg-fix-triage
outputs: Verified fixes and updated finding status.
prerequisites: A saved review report with open findings.
commands.summary: Apply review findings from a saved review report. Fixes all findings or a subset by ID/priority.

constraints: Cannot proceed without reproduction and verification evidence.
intents: run a red green bug workflow
commands.name: /cg-fixbug
outputs: A tested fix and verified bug solution artifact.
prerequisites: A specific bug symptom or report.
commands.summary: Structured bug-fix workflow: establish the expected-behavior source in Step 1.5, perform test-gap classification in Step 2.5, and require red-green proof.

constraints: Query text uses only validated prepared files, never shell interpolation.
The model can select only returned candidate IDs; it cannot compose the final answer.
Runtime support requires verified host evidence; static assets alone are not runtime proof.
Direct agent and skill assets are outside command help.
commands.name: /cg-help
outputs: Deterministic overview, exact help, workflow, bounded candidates, unsupported result, or recovery text.
prerequisites: The installed cg-help backend and its fresh catalog are available.
The host exposes invocation text and a structured in-place file-write tool.
commands.summary: Find evidence-backed Compound GPID slash and shell command help.

constraints: Filters ideas against project constraints and existing roadmap work.
intents: discover what to work on next
commands.name: /cg-ideate
outputs: A filtered and ranked list of improvement ideas.
prerequisites: A project that can be inspected for concrete signals.
commands.summary: Generate, critique, and filter improvement ideas for the project. Use before /cg-brainstorm when you want to discover what to work on next.

constraints: Status is the default read-only mode.
intents: link roadmap work to GitHub Issues
commands.name: /cg-issues
outputs: Issue status or validated issue-link mutations.
prerequisites: A GitHub repository and roadmap data.
commands.summary: Manage GitHub Issues linked to roadmap work items. Modes: status (default, read-only), backfill, link, adopt, setup.

constraints: Lightweight approval cannot override a hard or structural gate.
Stage 2 is limited to two discovery rounds.
Review may run each light agent at most twice.
commands.name: /cg-light-work
outputs: Implemented approved changes with deterministic and focused review evidence.
prerequisites: A single cohesive small task in a Git workspace with a resolvable HEAD.
commands.summary: Qualify and execute one small technical task with bounded discovery, light review, and explicit compounding consent.

constraints: Requires user approval for the completion contract.
commands.name: /cg-plan
outputs: A validated plan with a completion contract.
prerequisites: Clear requirements or an approved brainstorm.
commands.summary: Create a structured implementation plan with research. Use after brainstorming or when requirements are clear.

constraints: Reviews the plan and does not implement it.
commands.name: /cg-plan-review
outputs: Prioritized plan findings and user decisions.
prerequisites: An implementation plan to review.
commands.summary: Review an implementation plan for risks, over-engineering, missing edge cases, and flawed assumptions. Use after /cg-plan or on any existing plan.

constraints: Developer-only and guarded to the canonical repository.
commands.name: /cg-release
outputs: A controller request or, after publication checks, a GitHub Release and tag.
prerequisites: Run GPID publication in the canonical repository with release authority.
commands.summary: Run generic controller commands unchanged or publish a GPID four-part prerelease through the existing PowerShell release flow.

constraints: Theme selection is explicit and source type controls the renderer.
commands.name: /cg-render-doc
outputs: Validated curated HTML or a check result.
prerequisites: A project-contained supported Markdown source.
commands.summary: Render a workflow artifact or generic Markdown document to curated HTML. Routes typed artifacts to cg-render-artifact and generic documents to cg-publish-markdown. Supports --theme selection (reference or editorial).

constraints: Reports state and does not replace the active plan or review authority.
commands.name: /cg-resume
outputs: A bounded work-in-progress summary and next action.
prerequisites: An existing Compound GPID project.
commands.summary: Load context and resume interrupted work. Use at the start of a session to pick up where you left off.

constraints: Findings are primary and tests remain separate evidence.
commands.name: /cg-review
outputs: A saved P0-P3 review report.
prerequisites: A defined review scope or recent changes.
commands.summary: Run multi-agent code review on recent changes. Produces prioritized P0/P1/P2/P3 findings.

constraints: Does not modify roadmap state.
commands.name: /cg-roadmap-view
outputs: A read-only roadmap visualization in chat.
prerequisites: A roadmap.json file.
commands.summary: Visualize the project roadmap in chat. Supports flags: --milestone, --tasks, --detail, --status, --wip, --plan, --help. Dispatches @cg-roadmap-view agent for rendering.

constraints: Preserves existing project and roadmap content.
commands.name: /cg-setup
outputs: Project charter, strict local config, and workflow directories.
prerequisites: Compound GPID is linked into the project.
commands.summary: Configure Compound GPID for this project and load context for returning projects.

constraints: Canonical mutations require strict maintainer authority.
commands.name: /cg-skill
outputs: A validated skill lifecycle result or mutation plan.
prerequisites: The skill-management capability is installed.
commands.summary: Discover, import, validate, activate, update, audit, deprecate, and remove skills through one lifecycle command.

constraints: Roadmap writes are delegated to the roadmap authority.
commands.name: /cg-strategy
outputs: A strategy artifact and approved charter or roadmap proposals.
prerequisites: A project vision or strategic decision.
commands.summary: Strategic project visioning and direction-setting. Use when you have a full project in mind to structure, or when you need to rethink direction mid-project. Dispatches @cg-roadmap for all roadmap writes.

constraints: Stops instead of replacing unavailable tooling with broad model inspection.
commands.name: /cg-token-audit
outputs: Bounded cost, token, and recommendation artifacts.
prerequisites: The deterministic token-audit backend is available.
commands.summary: Analyze Compound GPID token/context usage and suggest cost-efficient workflow choices.

constraints: Propose mode is observe-only.
commands.name: /cg-verify-pr
outputs: A CI diagnosis and, when allowed, verified fixes.
prerequisites: A current pull request with accessible checks.
commands.summary: Check CI status on current PR, classify failures, and auto-fix with review agents. Use --propose for observe-only diagnosis.

constraints: Preserves manual content outside managed section markers.
commands.name: /cg-wiki
outputs: Wiki status or controlled wiki updates.
prerequisites: A project wiki configuration or permission to initialize it.
commands.summary: Manage the project wiki: initialize, rebuild pages, restructure sections, check status, or convert to GitHub Wiki format.

constraints: Stops at blocked completion evidence and respects plan boundaries.
Does not create inline Plans; use the separate /cg-light-work route for a small technical task without a saved Plan.
commands.name: /cg-work
outputs: Implemented changes with test and constraint evidence.
prerequisites: An approved saved Plan that passes validation.
commands.summary: Implement a /cg-plan plan. Supports /cg-work [phaseX], review, and deviate controls.

constraints: Surfaces consequential normative choices for human approval.
commands.name: /cr-brainstorm
outputs: A scoped research brainstorm artifact.
prerequisites: A research question or uncertain methodology choice.
commands.summary: Research brainstorm — clarify fuzzy research requirements. Classifies task type (theory, EDA, implementation, ML, writing, etc.) and guides methodology decisions. Use for economics and econometrics research tasks.

constraints: Requires evidence before knowledge capture.
commands.name: /cr-compound
outputs: A research-specific solution artifact.
prerequisites: A verified research solution.
commands.summary: Research compound — capture a solved research problem for future reuse. Extends /cg-compound with research-specific categories: identification, specification, derivation, ml-methodology, reproducibility.

constraints: Keeps evidence, identification, and implementation requirements explicit.
commands.name: /cr-plan
outputs: A research plan with integrity and verification gates.
prerequisites: A scoped research task or approved research brainstorm.
commands.summary: Research plan — structured implementation plan for research tasks. Use after /cr-brainstorm to create concrete steps.

constraints: Silent research correctness errors are blocking P0 findings.
commands.name: /cr-review
outputs: Prioritized research integrity and implementation findings.
prerequisites: Research code, outputs, or a defined methodology scope.
commands.summary: Research review — multi-agent code and methodology review. Orchestrates cg-* agents (code quality, testing, reproducibility) and cr-* agents (research integrity, mathematical verification, identification audit, econometric reasoning). Produces prioritized P0/P1/P2/P3 findings.

constraints: Enforces seed, provenance, and specification logging requirements.
commands.name: /cr-work
outputs: Implemented research code and evidence artifacts.
prerequisites: A validated research plan.
commands.summary: Research work — implement a research plan step by step. Supports /cr-work [phaseX]. Enforces P0 seed, provenance, and specification logging requirements.
